Webuild::1458549233.experience_required: 2–5 years in infrastructure engineering tender/design technical offices, master's in Civil Engineering or Architecture, technical drawings/BIM/CAD and public tender documentation.
Webuild::1458549233.mandatory_vs_preferred_requirements: Mandatory: MSc Civil Engineering or Architecture, 2–5 years technical design or infrastructure tenders, engineering coordination, Office, English and travel. Preferred: MS Project.
Webuild::1458549233.decision_scope_and_ownership: Coordinate technical tender responses, multi-disciplinary engineering drawings, infrastructure construction-method and BIM/CAD deliverables, timetables and external design consultants.
Webuild::1458549233.seniority_evidence: Specialist under Technical Coordination Director, no direct reports, but specifically 2–5 years design/tender experience and architecture/civil engineering degree compulsory.
Webuild::1458549233.salary: Official fixed gross annual salary €42,000–48,000, permanent, hybrid in Milan or Rome
Webuild::1458549233.rationale: Location and salary are appealing, but Webuild is explicitly excluded and a Civil Engineering/Architecture degree with practical infrastructure design/tender/BIM experience is mandatory; these are not business consulting skills.
